description: This file defines a 'keep in view' extension for a rich text editor, managing scroll behavior on window resize and selection updates.

classes.name: KeepInView
classes.description: An extension for the editor that keeps the last line in view during resize and selection updates.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the extension.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up window resize event listener if enabled in options.

methods.name: onSelectionUpdate
methods.description: Debounces and triggers keeping the last line in view on selection change.
